decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that Mint #1 receives no ticket when no earlier NFT exists.

The existing message-684 MODIFY already excludes the one-off first mint from the expected displayed commission total.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint ticket exception and the resulting one-ticket-per-primary-mint rule beginning after Mint #1.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that Small Block ticket generation begins after Mint #1 and preserves the first-mint exception.
